description: Append-only compact index of continuous workflow simulation session records. Raw evidence is local unless an explicitly accepted compact evidence bundle is committed.
append_policy: Add one immutable workflow_session record per executed baseline or treatment session. Completed workflow-simulation reproduction records must use sequential one-task-at-a-time prompt delivery and seed-origin concealment. Compare sessions only when task sequence, initial snapshot, runtime_id, provider, model, and model_condition_id are intentionally bound. Supersede rather than edit historical results except for path typo correction with rationale.

task_sequence.reset_policy: reset repository, profile home, tool state, indexes, caches, generated config, and agent home before the session; persist them between tasks

remaining_limitations: Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.
Full prevention requires fixtures built from pre-fix bases plus hidden verifier tests rather than production-code reverse patches.

persist_between_tasks: memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

cumulative_token_usage.pricing_basis: not computed; Codex-reported token volume, not billing-weighted cost

state_observations.useful_state_reuse_notes: Single persistent Codex thread resumed across one task prompt at a time.
